Alignment tracks: in-memory reads, a bam url or a cram url

Source: R/tracks.R
GenomicAlignmentTrack-class.Rd

GenomicAlignmentTrack holds a GAlignments object (GenomicAlignments, written to a bam file at display time; needs the suggested packages GenomicAlignments, rtracklayer and Rsamtools). RemoteAlignmentTrack and CramTrack point igv.js at a served bam or cram file and its index. Display them with loadTrack; color, height and visibilityWindow are sent to igv.js.

Usage

GenomicAlignmentTrack(
  trackName,
  alignment,
  trackHeight = 50,
  visibilityWindow = 30000,
  color = "gray"
)

RemoteAlignmentTrack(
  trackName,
  bamUrl,
  bamIndex = paste0(bamUrl, ".bai"),
  trackHeight = 50,
  visibilityWindow = 30000,
  color = "gray"
)

CramTrack(
  trackName,
  cramUrl,
  indexUrl,
  trackHeight = 50,
  visibilityWindow = 30000,
  color = "gray"
)

Arguments

trackName

A character string, used as track label by igv

alignment

a GAlignments object

trackHeight

track height in pixels

visibilityWindow

Maximum window size in base pairs for which reads are displayed

color

A CSS color name (e.g., "red" or "#FF0000"), or "random"

bamUrl

url of a bam file

bamIndex

url of its index; by default bamUrl with ".bai" appended

cramUrl

url of a cram file

indexUrl

url of its crai index

Value

An object of the named class

Slots

alignment

a GAlignments object

bamUrl

character, url of the bam file

bamIndex

character, url of its index

cramUrl

character, url of the cram file

indexUrl

character, url of its crai index

Examples

track <- CramTrack("cram demo", "https://example.com/reads.cram",
                   "https://example.com/reads.cram.crai")
trackInfo(track)
#> $trackType
#> [1] "alignment"
#> 
#> $fileFormat
#> [1] "cram"
#> 
#> $source
#> [1] "url"
#> 
#> $class
#> [1] "CramTrack"
#>
